assumptions: Current fixed universe; survivor selection may overstate history
As-of partitions bounded including nested expectations-gap readers
Historical financial/tone inputs remain the versions available in this partition; corrected v3 staging is not substituted
Each since date starts a fresh cash account; figures are not the actual user's account
Half exposure through the meeting, restore next open; event changes execute at next open even on green days
Conditional means negative five-session SPY move; once triggered it stays reduced through the event
Emergency 2020 actions excluded from pre-event research; sample starts in 2021
Comparison is exploratory, includes the incomplete lead-in to September 16, and is not causal evidence or an out-of-sample result
